https://www.realtor.com/realestateandhom.text: Truly one-of-a-kind opportunity to own your own castle in Cleveland. The home, thoughtfully & fully renovated in 2024, is ready for you to live like royalty! This magnificent property presents beautiful architectural details and original character with its stunning stained glass windows, gorgeous woodwork & wooden walls, fantastic turret. The home is tucked away and set back behind a lovely rock garden with refreshed landscaping. When approaching the castle, the spectacular stone structure is absolutely breathtaking, and upon entry, you're greeted by an impressive wooden staircase. The family room has a prominent stone fireplace, is the perfect size to gather with family & friends, and has a special additional seating area in the cozy nook. The half bath was modernized with sleek white tile & vanity, gold fixtures, and has a window. The kitchen was upgraded with new countertops, light fixtures, and stainless appliances while retaining the original stained glass windows & wood walls. The star of the room is the exquisite, wide, arched wall that leads to the light-filled dining room. Upstairs, you'll find a handsome & stately den with a bar, three bedrooms, and two full baths. The primary suite offers a bright & delightful full bath with tiled walk-in shower and bedroom with cathedral ceilings. The pretty second bath has a tub and is next to two additional bedrooms. Ample closet space and light are featured in one bedroom; whereas the other bedroom boasts dark wood ceilings, stone, and a majestic window that anchors the space. This home also features a basement that's great for storage, a back porch to enjoy your morning coffee, patio area to entertain, and a two-car garage. This stellar location is minutes from the Cleveland Metroparks Zoo, Downtown Cleveland, Tremont, Ohio City. Property comes fully furnished.

Welcome to this stunning, single-level ranch offering over 2,000+ square feet of beautifully updated living space! Combining classic charm with modern convenience, this home features: completely remodeled kitchen (2021). A chef's dream featuring crisp white cabinetry, sleek granite countertops, a stylish subway tile backsplash, and durable ceramic tile flooring designed for effortless maintenance, stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. The eat-in kitchen flows out through sliding doors to a backyard deck. Other highlights include warm gleaming hardwood floors (refinished 2022-2023) runs throughout the living room bedrooms and hallway, adding timeless character and seamless flow. Main bath off of the first floor hall offers newer vanity and ceramic tile flooring, a custom wet bar (2021), a beautiful home office, a cozy family room with built-in book shelves, a wood-burning fireplace. Second full bath is off the family room. 2-car garage with an attached workshop. Major mechanical peace of mind: New Hot Water Tank (2025), New Heating System (circa 2018), and New Roof (2023) Washer/Dryer (2025). Water pressure regulator replaced (2025). Office and laundry room vinyl flooring replaced 2025. Electrical panel upgraded 2021. Gutter guards installed. Walk across the street from Riverview Road to the National Park! Enjoy Brecksville Reservation just South on Riverview Road. Schedule your private showing today, we know you'll love it here!

Charming Ranch Living in a Peaceful Neighborhood! Discover the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and opportunity in this inviting 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath ranch nestled in a quiet neighborhood featuring sidewalks, perfect for evening strolls and enjoying the community. Inside, you'll find a spacious living room and a separate family room featuring a cozy fireplace, creating wonderful spaces for relaxing or entertaining. Luxury vinyl flooring adds a stylish touch, while updated bathrooms offer a fresh feel. Enjoy the convenience of first-floor laundry and the ease of comfortable one-floor living. Enjoy family meals around the kitchen table. The kitchen's ample counterspace offers plenty of space to roll out Christmas cookies or set up a buffet. All stainless appliances stay! The openness to the family room means you can watch the kids play or be part of the party while prepping your next charcuterie board! Looking for more space? The full basement offers endless possibilities and is ready for your finishing touches. Create the perfect recreation room, home theater, fitness space, or additional entertaining area. Step outside and enjoy the patio, perfect for morning coffee, summer gatherings, or simply unwinding outdoors. The property also features a 2-car attached garage, a handy storage shed, and a charming little bridge leading to an extended yard-adding a unique touch and even more room to enjoy the outdoors. With three bedrooms, 2.5 baths, multiple living spaces, and a wonderful combination of existing updates and opportunities to personalize, this home offers so much to love.

Discover the charm and potential of this spacious Cape Cod nestled on 1.5 picturesque acres in desirable Moreland Hills, within the Orange City School District. Offering 5 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and approximately 4000+ square feet of total living space, including a walkout lower level, this home features a welcoming foyer, expansive living areas, and beautiful natural wood accents throughout. The kitchen offers ample cabinetry, a center island with cooktop, an abundance of cabinets, and built-in double ovens. Enjoy the warmth and character of the family room, featuring exposed wood ceiling beams, a floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace, custom built-in cabinetry, creating an ideal setting for entertaining. An enclosed sunroom with skylight and expansive sliding glass doors provides a wonderful connection to the surrounding wooded scenery. The home also offers generously sized bedrooms, a full bathroom with dual-sink vanity, and a partially finished basement with additional flexible-use space, laundry hookups, and storage. Outside, enjoy the peaceful, tree-lined setting, expansive yard, and multi-level wood deck with built-in seating and screened-in porch area. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and the amenities of the surrounding Chagrin Valley area. A wonderful opportunity to make this property your own and enjoy the space, privacy, and setting that Moreland Hills has to offer! Boiler '25.

Tucked along a tree-lined, curving street in one of North Olmsted's most peaceful enclaves, 30401 Ginger Lane offers relaxed elegance and easy, low-maintenance living. A charming covered front porch sets the tone. Inside, the two-story foyer is crowned by an arched window that fills the entry with natural light. The heart of the home is a dramatic great room with a soaring vaulted ceiling and a gas fireplace framed by windows. At nearly 22 feet, it's an inviting place for quiet evenings or entertaining, and it flows into an adjoining dining area. The kitchen has abundant oak cabinetry and generous counter space, and it opens to a sun-drenched breakfast nook. From the nook, a slider leads to a private, fenced patio, ideal for morning coffee or dinner outdoors. The first-floor primary suite is a true retreat, with a walk-in closet, large vanity sink and a walk-in shower. Main-floor laundry, a powder room, and a dedicated utility room make everyday life easy. Upstairs, a gallery-style hallway overlooks the great room below. It leads to two spacious bedrooms, one with its own walk-in closet and a full bathroom. An attached two-car garage and fresh, neutral finishes complete this home. It's minutes from Great Northern's shopping and dining, local parks, and I-480 and I-90. Ginger Lane is ready to welcome you home. Schedule your private showing today.

A truly remarkable intown estate offering exceptional scale and craftsmanship, this one-of-a-kind Charles Fazio-designed residence is sited on an almost 5-acre parcel offering incredible privacy. Built with the finest materials, this classic American country manor home with "timeless East Coast architecture" is simply beyond compare. The exterior is a work of art with white clapboard siding, divided-light windows, decorative balcony railings, a slate roof, and a wraparound front porch with Ipe flooring. A private front vestibule opens into the most magnificent two-story foyer which features a grand reverse staircase, paneled walls, and a spectacular Palladian window. Highlights of the first floor include a magnificently paneled library with handsome fireplace, a grand formal dining room, and an elegant living room accessed off of a second foyer area with floor-to-ceiling custom-built ins. The kitchen area is second to none with an integrated family room and an expansive beamed ceiling which unifies the space. Included is a private scullery, a gracious breakfast room with fireplace, and walls of windows which overlook a covered veranda, stone terrace, and breathtaking yard. The expansive second floor is accessed by two gracious staircases and offers 6 gracious bedroom suites all with private bathrooms. The owner's suite has a sitting room, fireplace, two walk-in dressing rooms, an elegant marble bathroom, and private outdoor terrace. The completely finished lower level includes multiple entertaining areas, an exercise room with sauna, and a second kitchen area. There is a private apartment which is accessed from the back hall and is perfect for guests or an Au Pair. The outdoor space is breathtaking with a gently rolling lawn framed by mature trees offering total privacy and unlimited space for entertaining. A tennis court and basketball court (pickleball as well) are outstanding additions to this serene estate setting!

Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated, this inviting Beachcliff II Colonial offers wonderful living spaces, timeless character, and an exceptional Rocky River location on one of the city's most distinctive streets. A welcoming entry opens to the formal living and dining rooms, providing beautiful spaces for entertaining and gathering with family and friends. The updated kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and hardwood floors that extend into the spacious family room addition. Filled with natural light, this comfortable gathering space is sure to become a favorite spot in the home. Just beyond, a charming three-season room offers a peaceful place to relax while overlooking the beautifully landscaped backyard. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, a full bath, and access to a walk-up attic offering excellent additional storage. The finished lower level has been recently refreshed with a beautifully updated family room, perfect for movie nights, recreation, or casual entertaining, along with a renovated full bathroom. The laundry room has also been updated with new luxury vinyl tile flooring, adding both style and practicality. Outside, the backyard offers a private retreat with mature landscaping and a newly added stone patio, creating a wonderful setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the warmer months. The location is equally special, situated along one of Rocky River's picturesque streets known for its historic landscaped center strip, which residents take pride in maintaining and enjoying throughout the seasons. As a bonus, homeowners enjoy Wagar Beach privileges, offering access to one of Rocky River's treasured lakefront amenities. A wonderful combination of thoughtful updates, inviting indoor and outdoor living spaces, and an exceptional Beachcliff II location!

Welcome home to this spacious 4-bedroom Cape Cod, ideally situated on a generous corner lot! With hardwood floors throughout the entire first floor, a finished basement, and an oversized two-car garage with a walk-up loft, this home offers the space, storage, and features that today's buyers are looking for. The first floor features beautiful hardwood floors throughout, including the living room, dining room, and two bedrooms. The kitchen and a full bathroom complete the main level. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms, offering flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. The finished basement provides even more usable space, complete with a full bathroom and bar area. Outside, enjoy the spacious, fully fenced backyard with a concrete patio and two storage sheds. The oversized two-car garage is a standout feature, offering a walk-up loft with additional space for storage, hobbies, or a workshop. A covered stone front porch adds to the home's charm and provides a great place to relax. Additional features include updated mechanicals, updated electrical, newer siding, roof, HVAC, and triple-pane windows. With four bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a finished basement, and plenty of additional storage, this home has so much to offer. Come see it for yourself and schedule your private showing today!

Welcome to this charming brick home situated on a beautiful 1.75-acre lot surrounded by mature trees and plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors! This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home is full of character, featuring original hardwood floors, beautiful woodwork, and two fireplaces that add warmth and charm throughout. The spacious living areas offer plenty of natural light, while the kitchen features its original cabinetry and unique vintage tilework. Downstairs, you'll find additional living and entertaining space complete with a bar, perfect for gatherings or relaxing at home. Although currently offering two bedrooms, the spacious attic provides wonderful potential for additional bedrooms, living space, or storage. This home has also seen numerous improvements over the years, including connection to city sewer and the addition of washer and dryer hookups in the mudroom (hook ups still remain in basement as well), an updated bathroom/shower in 2021, and a new garage door, wrapped exterior wood trim, and replacement windows in 2024 (excluding bedroom windows, which were previously replaced). Outside, the expansive 1.75-acre property offers a peaceful setting with plenty of open yard space, wooded area and room to make it your own. With its timeless character, generous space, and numerous updates, this home is ready for its next chapter!

A quiet cul-de-sac setting, inviting living spaces, and a backyard made for enjoying the outdoors highlight this four-bedroom Rocky River home. Inside, hardwood floors bring warmth to the main level, while the spacious living room features a gas fireplace, crown molding, and a large picture window that fills the space with natural light. The adjoining dining room opens directly to the back deck, creating an easy connection between indoor gatherings and outdoor entertaining. The kitchen offers white cabinetry, generous counter space, and a mosaic tile backsplash. Four bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office, while two full baths add everyday convenience. Downstairs, a comfortable family room offers a second place to gather, watch movies, or simply spread out, with direct access to the outdoors from the utility room. The fully fenced backyard features a spacious deck, above-ground pool, storage shed, and mature landscaping that adds a sense of privacy. Roof 2017. Beyond the property, enjoy an outstanding Rocky River location less than a mile from the Recreation Center, High School, and Middle School with the scenic trails and natural beauty of the Rocky River Reservation less than a 10-minute drive away.

Elegant perfection in the heart of the prestigious Shaker Heights Club District, this charming and impeccably updated home seamlessly blends timeless architectural detail with modern luxury. From the moment you enter, you'll be captivated by the craftsmanship, refined finishes, freshly refinished hardwood floors throughout and warm sophistication throughout. The highlight of the first floor is the stunning chef-inspired custom eat-in kitchen, thoughtfully remodeled with custom cabinetry, a spacious center island, quartz countertops, and state-of-the-art appliances. A dream space for both everyday living and entertaining. The gracious dining room features a beautiful fireplace, while the light-filled living room showcases leaded glass French doors and a striking carved stone fireplace with an intricate wood surround. The living room flows effortlessly into an inviting four-season sunroom, where French doors open to a stone patio, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor entertaining experience. A handsome wood-paneled office with custom built-in cabinetry completes the first floor. The second floor offers five generous bedrooms and three full baths, including an expansive primary suite with an attached newly renovated bath with tiled shower and elegant timeless finishes. The third floor provides two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and abundant storage space. The lower level is truly an entertainer's dream, featuring a custom bar with wraparound island seating, theatre screen and seating area, gaming space, and exceptional room for hosting family and friends. This immaculate home is ideally located close to shopping, restaurants, golf, tennis, pools, hospitals, Rapid Transit, and much more.

Spacious Westlake Condo custom-built luxury unit. 1st floor features 9 Ft ceilings & a grand staircase. Next to the foyer, the "turret" room with south facing windows for a quiet study, dining room or reading room. The gourmet kitchen offers abundant, custom cabinetry, upscale built-in appliances, a fashionable range hood, granite counters & bar seating. All appliances remain. The kitchen opens to a wonderful great room with a gas fireplace, unique mantle, hearth, and sliding doors to a Trex deck. The first-floor primary suite includes a private office/exercise/sitting room adjacent to the sleeping area. The primary bedroom is enhanced by a see-through gas fireplace and sliding doors out to the elevated Trex deck. The luxurious primary bath with granite counters, makeup vanity, jetted tub, walk-in shower AND a huge walk-in closet. On the 1st floor is a pretty, updated powder room. Dedicated laundry room with ample counter space, cabinetry, and utility tub. The wide staircase up to three additional bedrooms. A 2nd private suite features a light-filled bedroom with a gas fireplace and large walk-in closet and bath. This private bath has granite counters, additional cabinetry, a jetted tub, and a walk-in shower. 2 more bedrooms each have generous closet space and access to a full bath. Completing the 2nd floor is a smart kitchenette with white cabinetry, sink, and refrigerator. Bonus walk-in storage room. The basement level is 1700 sq ft of unfinished space. It is a walk-out basement with door to the yard AND a high (11 course) ceiling! Includes an ELEVATOR to access all 3 levels, 1 year old, zoned, whole house GENERATOR, SOLID DOORS, 3 FT WIDE DOORWAYS, 75-gallon H2O tank, humidifier, air purifier and more! Enjoy maintenance-free living in the wonderful Eastern Westlake community

Welcome to this gorgeous ranch in the cul-de-sac community of Edgerton Commons, ideally located across the street from Briarwood Golf Club and just minutes from the Broadview Heights Recreation Center and Metroparks! As you enter this 2022 Petros-built home, you will be impressed by the quality, style, and finishes throughout. You're greeted by high ceilings, beautiful high-end fixtures, a stone fireplace, wide-plank flooring, coffered ceilings, and custom drapery. The kitchen features gorgeous cabinetry, quartz countertops, an 8-burner stove, a fully integrated refrigerator, and a pantry. The open-concept living area leads to the covered porch and equally impressive backyard, featuring EXTENSIVE hardscaping and a lot that backs up to the Metroparks! Exterior features include a natural gas line for a grill, a Rain Bird sprinkler system, a drip irrigation system for hands-free watering, and a 5-zone Sonos sound system that extends throughout the home. Additional interior features include CAT6 wiring throughout and fiber internet. The primary suite offers an incredible walk-in closet, tiled shower, and dual vanity with quartz countertops. Two additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, an office, and a laundry room with access from both the garage and side entry complete the first floor. The partially finished basement features 9 courses, approximately 2,400 square feet of space, a half bathroom, automatic blinds, and abundant storage space! The home is also equipped for a generator, and the 3-car garage is gas-heated for year-round comfort. This home is straight out of a magazine, with exceptional finishes to match! From the beautiful lot to the thoughtful details throughout, this home is truly a must-see!

Spacious brick 3-bedroom Colonial tucked into a private wooded setting with beautiful park-like green space surrounding the property. Step inside to a welcoming living room featuring hardwood floors, a large bay window and fireplace. The home offers plenty of room to spread out, including a family room with skylights, a finished basement recreation room and an office with built-in book shelves. The spacious owner's suite features its own private balcony - an ideal spot to relax and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Additional highlights include two fireplaces, hardwood flooring, a walk-up attic offering valuable additional space, and abundant character throughout. Outside enjoy a large front and back yard, deck and two-car garage, all surrounded by mature trees and expansive green space. The roof is approximately 2 years old, and a home warranty is included for added peace of mind. A wonderful combination of space, privacy, character and natural surroundings!

Don't miss this spacious 3-bedroom, 2 full bath ranch in delightful Mayfield Heights. This well-maintained home offers abundant living space and storage plus the ease of one floor living. The eat in kitchen, has two pantries, ceramic tile, ceiling fan, with all appliances included. The adjacent dining room flows into a bright and spacious living room with plenty of space to relax. Open the privacy doors to the hall and find three nice size bedrooms with ceiling fans and sliding door closets, a full bath plus, three hall closets providing ample storage. The lower lever offers additional living and entertainment space with a paneled recreation room, a large bonus room with built in shelves, perfect for playroom, crafting or exercise room, a full bathroom, laundry room and glass block windows. Washer, dryer and refrigerator all stay. New vinyl siding (2021), new hot water tank (2025). Double paned windows throughout. Central air conditioning and furnace serviced yearly. One and a half car garage, covered patio, and fenced in backyard. Located within the Mayfield School District, near shopping, dining, parks, and major highways. Schedule a showing, and make this home yours. All details shared are considered reliable but not guaranteed. Buyers and their agents are encouraged to conduct their own due diligence to confirm information.

Tucked into a secluded, wooded 2.5-acre setting, this custom English Cotswold home pairs distinctive architecture with extraordinary craftsmanship. With nearly 4,000 square feet, four bedrooms, and two full and one half baths, it offers inviting gathering spaces, quiet retreats, and a sense of privacy that defines the experience. Gothic arched windows, handcrafted solid wood doors, custom iron hardware, and solid wood millwork bring depth and character to the interior. Solid wood floors throughout and custom built-in oak cabinetry reflect the care invested in every space while providing exceptional storage. The vaulted great room features a wood-burning fireplace and connects to the kitchen, where custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, double ovens, a five-burner gas range with griddle, and a generous pantry support everyday cooking and entertaining. A separate dining room provides space for memorable dinners. With its own wood-burning fireplace and private wooded views, the hearth room offers an inviting place to unwind. The library features built-in bookcases, while an adjoining, tucked-away sitting room creates a beautiful retreat for reading, music, or quiet conversation. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features extensive built-in storage and generous closet space. Three additional bedrooms and a steam shower add to the home's comfort. Surrounded by trees and gardens, the tiered terrace creates a secluded outdoor retreat with a dedicated outdoor kitchen and space for dining, entertaining, and lingering into the evening. From its distinctive windows to its handcrafted finishes, this is a home to appreciate for its architecture, enjoy for its privacy, and remember for its character. Experience the craftsmanship, explore the quiet spaces, and discover the privacy of this woodland retreat. Schedule your private showing.

Welcome home to this spacious and well-maintained ranch offering comfortable one-floor living with room for everyone!Ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home sits on a beautifully landscaped lot with welcoming curb appeal, an oversized driveway, and mature trees that provide privacy and shade. Step inside to discover an expansive living room filled with natural light, perfect for gathering with family and friends. The warm, wood-paneled dining room features a beautiful brick fireplace and walls of windows overlooking the backyard, creating an inviting space for entertaining year-round. The spacious eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, and plenty of storage. With 4 generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, there's flexibility for large families, guests, or dedicated home office space. A convenient first-floor laundry room adds to the home's functionality, while the walk-up attic provides excellent storage or future expansion potential. Outside, enjoy the peaceful backyard with mature landscaping, patio space, and plenty of room for outdoor activities. An attached garage and ample driveway parking complete this exceptional property. Located near Bain Park this home is full of potential and ready for its next owner to make it their own. Schedule your private showing today! Hardwood floors under carpet!

Welcome to 3407 Wellington Ave - a tastefully remodeled 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home offering 1,340 sq ft of move-in ready living space in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods. This home has been thoughtfully updated from top to bottom, featuring brand new flooring throughout, a modernized kitchen with updated finishes, and beautifully refreshed bathrooms. Natural light pours through every room, highlighting the quality of every upgrade. Situated on a picturesque, tree-lined street in the Parma City School District, this property checks every box for buyers seeking comfort, style, and convenience. Whether you're a first-time buyer or looking to downsize without compromise, this home delivers. Schedule your private showing today - homes like this don't last!

First Floor Living. Move-In Ready! Fully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offering with updated finishes throughout. The light-filled living and dining areas feature a brick fireplace, built-in shelving, updated flooring, and fresh paint. The renovated kitchen includes white shaker-style cabinets, black hardware, and a subway tile backsplash. An updated full bathroom on the first floor and a second full bath in the lower level add convenience. Major improvements include a new roof, HVAC system, electrical panel and meter, driveway, and newly built detached garage. A covered front porch, back porches, and fenced backyard provide space to enjoy the outdoors. With extensive updates already completed, this home is move in ready!

"Imagine enjoying the convenience of first-floor living without sacrificing the space your family needs!" Look no further! This beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2-full-bath Cape Cod offers over 2,500 sq. ft. in the heart of Strongsville! New shake-style siding creates beautiful curb appeal before you step inside. Enter through the grand foyer featuring soaring vaulted ceilings and a modern statement chandelier. Fresh paint, brand-new carpet, and updated light fixtures throughout give this home a bright, move-in-ready feel, while a dedicated first-floor office provides the perfect work-from-home space. Enjoy first-floor living with a spacious primary suite featuring a newly remodeled bathroom and walk-in closet, plus main-level laundry. The charming farmhouse-style eat-in kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, including a brand-new refrigerator, and opens to a cozy family room with a gas-log fireplace perfect for crisp fall evenings. Enjoy warmer days on the large back patio with a retractable awning and LED lighting. The main level also features an inviting living room with a custom bay window and a dining room perfect for entertaining. Upstairs you'll find 3 generously sized bedrooms, a freshly remodeled full bath, abundant storage, and an incredible bonus flex space ready to become an additional primary suite, playroom, library, or private retreat. The finished basement adds more entertaining space with a wet bar and custom built-in bookcase. For added peace of mind, the HVAC system is approximately 4 years old. Move-in ready and made to impress, this Strongsville home combines comfort, style, and convenience! With shopping, dining, parks, and the Ohio Turnpike just minutes away, everything you need is at your fingertips. Homes with this much space, character, and thoughtful updating don't come around often! Schedule your private showing today and see why this one might be "the one!"

Great opportunity to own this solid, all-brick Cape Cod in a desirable neighborhood! Situated on a quiet street, this spacious home offers a great combination of location, character, and potential. Featuring a functional, contemporary floor plan with 4 generously sized bedrooms, a 2-car garage, and a bone-dry basement with laundry hookups, this home has plenty of space to meet your needs. Inside, you'll find beautiful original woodwork throughout and rock-solid, genuine hardwood floors that can be refinished to restore their original beauty. The kitchen features solid cabinetry in good condition and durable, large-format natural stone tile flooring. The full-brick construction adds to the home's timeless appeal and solid character. This property needs some TLC and cosmetic updates but offers tremendous potential for homeowners and investors alike. Bring your vision and make this solid home shine again. Property is professionally winterized, and utilities are currently off. Sold as-is. Don't miss this opportunity to own a spacious brick home in a great location at an affordable price!

Welcome home to this charming and cozy 3-bedroom ranch in Parma Heights! Freshly painted with new LVT flooring, this home offers a warm and inviting feel from the moment you walk in. The thoughtfully designed floor plan creates a spacious feel while maximizing the home's living space. Enjoy the outdoors on the covered concrete patio, or gather around the backyard fire pit. The partially fenced yard features chain-link fencing. The extended driveway parking pad provides additional parking convenience, along with a one-car garage. All appliances stay, including a dishwasher just one year old. Conveniently located near The Shoppes at Parma, local restaurants, shopping, entertainment, Metroparks and with easy access to downtown Cleveland. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy comfortable living in a convenient location! Call for a private tour today!

If you're looking for a solid brick ranch in Parma to add your personal touch to you've just found one here on Boundary Lane! Offering the ease of single-floor living, this 3 bedroom, 1.5 bathroom classic brick ranch has a lot of potential for the right owner. Hardwood flooring throughout most of the first floor. This property has a nice-sized backyard and is partially fenced. Located near shopping, schools, parks and public transportation, you'll love the location as it puts you right in the middle of everything Parma has to offer! All appliances included! Don't miss this opportunity!

Updated and movie in ready 3 Bedrm 2 full bath all remodeled ranch! Fully updated finished basement, new hot water tank (2026) open kitchen spacious dining 2 car garage, updated landscaping, newer windows. SHOW AND SELL!! Mayfield Heights Point of sale complete, violation free.

Welcome Home to the perfect blend of original charm and character along with modern updates throughout! This home is truly one of a kind! It is fully updated throughout, with over 2,900 sq ft, 5 bedrooms with the possibility of a 6th on the first floor and nestled on over 3 beautiful acres in Olmsted Township! What started out as timeless barn style architecture and still featuring the original barn beam in different areas of the home has been transformed into your dream home! You'll immediately notice the complete renovation of the exterior and garage from the new roof, siding, gutters, soffit, fascia, windows, doors, landscape and more! The front porch will welcome you in! As you step inside, the beauty of the home really shines with wood flooring throughout the family room, gas fireplace with custom wood detail and bay window. It is open to the dining room with sliders that to lead outside. The kitchen is truly the heart of this home! You'll love the exposed beams, cherry cabinetry, tons of counterspace, dual ovens and sinks plus granite countertops. French doors lead you into the large den with beautiful stone wood burning fireplace, built in bookshelves and closet. This would be a great space for a first floor bedroom! There is a half bath on the first floor for convenience. Upstairs, you'll find 5 bedrooms including the spacious master bedroom with dual walk in closets and it's own private bath with dual sinks, granite countertops and tile shower. The full basement offers even more with a rec room, workshop, laundry area and storage. Wait until you step outside onto the deck that overlooks the property! With acreage, mature trees, new pond, new pool, play set for children, firepit area, stone walkways...it feels like your own private retreat! There's also a detached 2-car garage. A complete list of updates is available including furnace, h20 tank and more! You simply won't find this in a newer home which is a reminder of just how special this home really is!
